change: Original main strict proof instructions retained. Application proves and displays the complete source span between uniquely located selected quotes, including every intervening word, capped at4000; ambiguous or oversized multi-quote context refuses. Sources never merge. Selected-ID scope/duration/strength guards run before context assembly; named IDs also required in claim text. Proof reason limit1000 diagnostic chars; approval boolean/type/extra-field/schema checks retained.
stop_rule: One frozen candidate, one call per fixed-draft control, one normal retrieval-to-answer trial per known case only if every control matches. Preserve all failures, no retuning or selective retries. No new call after 55 chat calls or 2700 seconds.
pr_acceptance: Every control matches with no model/schema error; proof/display quote equivalence and exact binding regressions pass; source review finds no material unsupported displayed claim or attribution error and both unanswerable controls refuse in the broader check. Other answerable refusals remain explicit product limitations; no general completeness improvement inferred.
product_acceptance: The local-v1 requirement of five of six complete answers and both control refusals with no material unsupported claim is unchanged. Known r3 replay cannot satisfy fresh validation or approve v1.
limits: Inspected questions, one stochastic trial, no baseline rerun or human review. Read-only current database and newly retrieved passages; not a performance baseline.
